submitted.rationale: EQE drops steadily as Sb fraction rises: 0.0215% at Sb=0.195, 0.0098% at 0.324, 0.0058% at 0.399, 0.00093% at 0.502, 0.00028% at 0.680. Under 2.1 eV illumination, compositions richer in Pb absorb more. Index 1 is the best composition measured. The untested index 0 (Sb=0.15) may be higher still.
